about: Filo's first-wave approved brands, picked from the evidence in seed_brands.json on 20 Oct 2026. Brooklyn asked Claude to go with these. Approving a brand only lets its products be considered; each product still needs a pass or conditional decision confirmed by Brooklyn.

why.&Daughter: Directory: made in the UK and Ireland with mills in Ireland and Scotland. Not in V1. Only 6 reviews, some pilling complaints, so screen carefully.
why.Another Tomorrow: High evidence: traceability-led womenswear; garment-level supply-chain disclosure.
why.Armedangels: High evidence: certified organic and recycled ranges. Made in Portugal, Tunisia, Romania, Turkey, Germany. Trustpilot 4.4 (1,808). Good On You: Great.
why.Asket: Very high evidence in Research V1: product-level supply chain, cost and footprint disclosure; EU manufacturing for most cut-and-sew. Trustpilot 2.6 (149) mostly on returns and some lines.
why.Babaà: Directory: every item made in Spain from Spanish wool and cotton. Not in V1. Only 1 review.
why.Blackhorse Lane Ateliers: High evidence: London denim atelier, local production, repair focus.
why.Colorful Standard: High evidence; made in its own factory in Barcelos, Portugal. Good On You: Good.
why.Community Clothing: High evidence: every garment made in the UK with 28 partner factories.
why.Finisterre: High evidence: repair and material responsibility programs. Check each product's fibre: many technical pieces are synthetic.
why.Hessnatur: High evidence: natural-material focus, mostly made in Europe. Trustpilot 3.7 (2,579). Good On You: Good.
why.Hiut Denim: High evidence: Welsh denim maker with local manufacturing.
why.Jamieson's of Shetland: High evidence: heritage Shetland wool, Scottish production. Verify animal welfare and yarn traceability.
why.John Smedley: High evidence: long-established UK fine-gauge knitwear manufacturer.
why.Kotn: High evidence: direct relationships with cotton farmers in Egypt, published supply-chain approach.
why.Kowtow: High evidence: certified organic cotton and supply-chain transparency. Womenswear.
why.Kuyichi: High evidence: organic and recycled denim focus. Trustpilot 4.4 (61). Good On You: Great.
why.L'Envers: High evidence: made to order in family-owned Spanish ateliers; non-mulesed wool. Primarily womenswear.
High evidence: Los Angeles-made basics focused on fabric and construction. Labour traceability upstream is limited.
why.MUD Jeans: High evidence: circular denim, recycled cotton, published reporting.
why.Naked & Famous Denim: High evidence: cut and sewn in Canada from Japanese denim. A Canadian brand for Filo's home market.
why.Nudie Jeans: Very high evidence: published suppliers, free repairs, resale. Good On You: Great. Trustpilot 2.0 (223) mostly sizing, repair waits and returns.
why.Peregrine: High evidence: family-run British maker; British wool, made in Manchester.
why.Sunspel: Directory: T-shirts made in its own factory in Long Eaton, England. Not in V1, so screen products first. Trustpilot 1.7 (108) is service, not quality.

left_out_for_now.People Tree: UK business in liquidation since Sept 2023
left_out_for_now.Patagonia, Eileen Fisher: Strong evidence but less aligned with Filo's style direction; easy to add later
left_out_for_now.The RealReal: Resale source; phase in after the first 120 new products
